Description: Third-person singular feminine pronouns (she/her) used as subjects and objects in sentences.
Contractions representing auxiliary verbs and "to be" verbs in informal speech and writing.
First-person singular pronoun "I" used as the subject of sentences in conversational and narrative contexts.
Words that begin sentences after a period or other sentence-ending punctuation
Single digits (2, 7, 8, 9) appearing as numerical values or identifiers in statistical, medical, or scientific data contexts.
All instances are the existential word "there" used in "there is/are/were/has been" constructions to indicate the existence or presence of something.
